notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least four charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {5}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
